name: os
story: My product calls lived in my head, so nobody could argue with them. I wrote them down as fourteen rules and test them like code against 56 real cases. The last run passed 111 of 168, and the weakest rules are the ones I fix next.

name: High Leverage Research
story: AI research sounds just as sure of itself when it is wrong. So I set it up as an investment committee instead of a single voice, and nothing publishes until I sign it.

name: Midwatch
story: Agents that write code will ship it too if nobody stops them. Instead of one agent doing everything, Midwatch runs like a small team: one plans, one builds and one reviews, each coming to the work fresh, so none of them grades its own work. The ship decision stays with me.
